cells: 150 events and recurring series across Texas, Oklahoma and Louisiana markets. Research checked November 16, 2026.
Open Conference circuit. Use the filter arrows to browse specialties, states, dates, fees and source links.
Set Your choice to Pick, Maybe or Pass. Every entry starts at Review, so you can make all selections.
Blank dates mean unannounced or conflicting dates. Posted dates alone do not confirm an in-state venue or commercial eligibility.
Entry fees are the smallest published commercial exhibit option found. Packages and calculated early rates are labeled; travel and extras are separate.
Market counts include state association series whose next venue is pending. A geography hold needs location confirmation before travel planning.
Known fees use current numeric exhibit prices. A missing quote keeps Complete cash total unavailable. Overlaps count event entries, not pairs. Separate teams may cover simultaneous events.
Travel, extras and booth kit are editable planning estimates for the whole team. TexMed lead retrieval is a published add-on. Staff time is excluded.
One row per distinct event or recurring series. Co-located tracks, workshops inside a congress and duplicate calendar listings are counted once.
Dated events, 2027 announcements awaiting dates, recurring watchlist entries and date conflicts are labeled separately.
Includes outpatient practices, med spas, allied health and broader hospital / academic events so you can judge the audience yourself.
LMGMA and Southern Pain Society need physical-location confirmation. National meetings confirmed outside TX / OK / LA are excluded.
Fee blanks mean no verified current commercial price. Historical rates, attendee admission and sponsorships without confirmed space stay in notes.
Turn selected events into a sales pipeline
6–8 weeks before: identify attending practice owners / managers and request the current exhibitor contract for each Pick.
3–4 weeks before: book meetings through permitted channels. Use an event-specific QR form with practice, website, work contact, need and meeting time.
At the event: log conversations in Lead pipeline using its Event ID. Capture the decision maker, business need, permission and next action.
Within 48 hours: deliver the agreed practice-specific audit and set the next meeting. Track proposals and wins by originating Event ID.
Keep chiropractic practices in Longview and surrounding areas on hold. Respect organizer list terms and do-not-contact requests.

workflowInstructions: Open Conference circuit. Use the filter arrows to browse specialties, states, dates, fees and source links.
Set Your choice to Pick, Maybe or Pass. Every entry starts at Review, so you can make all selections.

Known fees use current numeric exhibit prices. A missing quote keeps Complete cash total unavailable. Overlaps count event entries, not pairs. Separate teams may cover simultaneous events.
Travel, extras and booth kit are editable planning estimates for the whole team. TexMed lead retrieval is a published add-on. Staff time is excluded.
One row per distinct event or recurring series. Co-located tracks, workshops inside a congress and duplicate calendar listings are counted once.
Dated events, 2027 announcements awaiting dates, recurring watchlist entries and date conflicts are labeled separately.
